title: Bruegel office and event venue at Rue de la Charité 33
summary: Bruegel's first-party event pages repeatedly place Bruegel-hosted activity at Rue de la Charité 33, 4th floor, 1210 Brussels. The evidence supports an operating office/event venue, not an explicit headquarters or legal-seat designation.
